purpose: Read-only implementation review of the P6 decomposed per-instance baseline

answers.1_predictor_structure: (a) ONE shared regressor over all vision views; 3 boosters per platform (one per fold), 6 total; no per-model split, no model one-hot -- identity enters only via static-profile numerics. Groups/folds inherited verbatim from P1's group_to_fold (train_decomposed.py:100-112)
answers.2_learner: XGBoost via the same analysis_common helpers as direct; _PARAMS seed=42, _PARAM_GRID 4 combos, rounds=300; outer 3-fold groupwise identical to P1; inner hyperparameter CV is group-aware
answers.3_features: 18 = 12 own (_view_features) + 6 co-runner summaries (co.same_dev_load_sum, co.same_dev_count, co.other_dev_load_sum, co.other_dev_count, co.set_has_gen, co.gen_on_accel). NOT a pure per-instance feature set. All plan-level; no measured per-view dynamics
answers.4_attainment: eff = min(infps, cap); cap = 1000/static_infer_ms from sample_profiling_data.json; ratio = thr/eff; target = min(1.0, ratio); clipped count is 0 on both platforms
answers.5_composition: y1 = sum(r*eff)/Fmax_measured; y2 = clip01(unweighted mean(1-r)) then affine min-max against the group's MEASURED y2 lo/hi. Neither a threshold nor a learned map. P6 therefore needs measured group stats at predict time; P1 does not
answers.6_y3: shared verbatim -- P1's OOF y3_pred read from groupkfold_{platform}_oof.csv (:114-115); no artifact load, no retraining
answers.7_appendix_C: all 8 reported values trace to specific lines and match decomposed_metrics.json exactly; re-execution deliberately NOT performed (it would overwrite committed artifacts)

manuscript_mismatches.issue: 'predicts the degradation of each task separately' reads as per-task models; implementation is one shared regressor

composition also uses the group's MEASURED Fmax and y2 lo/hi, so P6 requires measured group stats that P1 does not -- an asymmetry in the comparison (which happens to favor P6, so the conclusion is conservative)
'ports their structure' -- the port includes 6 co-runner features; Kim's original feature set cannot be checked from this repo
0.993/0.992 and 0.834/0.763 are POOLED Spearman while Table 1's .931/.911 are GROUP-MEAN, used without distinction; the code also computes group-mean y2 recon (0.877/0.720) which is not reported
attainment upper clip min(1.0,.) not mentioned; 0 rows clipped
composition loss cause not stated: unweighted mean, generative views excluded, request-count weighting not reproduced

y3_statement_verdict: manuscript :124 on y3 sharing MATCHES the code
unknowns: Kim et al. ICCD2024 original feature set (outside this repo)
